name: PlasmaWave-TS-TW
title: Plasma Wave
description: Glowing three-dimensional ribbons of cyan and magenta twist like neon tubes through a dark space. The shapes curl and travel continuously, lit from within and fading at the edges.
use: A bold dark hero needs a futuristic burst of neon depth behind a short headline.
avoid: You need full-frame coverage or calm: the ribbons sit in a horizontal band and never pause.
a11y: Decorative and always moving, with no reduced-motion check and nothing to operate. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A cluster of thick glowing loops and bands across the middle of a black frame, mostly bright cyan with magenta-violet tubes threading between them. Surfaces are smooth and rounded with hot white highlights, and the top and bottom stay black.
behaves: The ribbons roll and slide along their length at a steady pace, knots loosening and tightening. Nothing reacts to the pointer; the motion is a single endless loop.
customise: The two colours, both speeds and bend values, focal length, offset, rotation and second-wave direction are props. The ribbon geometry is fixed.
weight: heavy: A per-pixel raymarch runs every frame, up to fourteen steps per pixel.
